# GSE63310 processed enrichment fixtures

These six tables are derived public-data inputs for application workflow tests. They are not synthetic clustering truth labels and do not establish a new biological finding. Each file is an ordinary richStudio enrichment TSV; `sha256.json` records its exact identity.

Source study: [GEO GSE63310](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE63310), [Sheridan et al., 2015](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12885-015-1187-z). Original count archive: `https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE63nnn/GSE63310/suppl/GSE63310_RAW.tar`, SHA256 `d2567b6753711e86820acbed4a4786ea1c57c59212503a8622b56982bcd53e44`. GEO SOFT metadata: `https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE63nnn/GSE63310/soft/GSE63310_family.soft.gz`, SHA256 `c92b7ce8a4405a941a1b6baada7ac52a241bd7dc7a66ab8ddaea44f5aa3e12c2`. Sources were retrieved on 2026-10-28.

The analysis used nine primary mouse mammary epithelial population samples, three each for Basal, luminal progenitor (LP), and mature luminal (ML). Included accessions are GSM1545535, GSM1545536, GSM1545538–GSM1545542, GSM1545544 and GSM1545545. Mammosphere and CommaDB cultures were excluded. Comparisons are Basal−LP, Basal−ML and LP−ML; `up` means higher in the first named population and `down` in the second. These contrasts share samples.

Derivation: raw integer counts → edgeR `filterByExpr` across the nine samples and TMM normalization → batch-adjusted limma-voom (`~0 + group + batch`) → within-contrast BH <0.05 and |log2FC| >=1 → six directional Entrez-ID lists → clusterProfiler GO Biological Process ORA with a shared measured/annotated background, term sizes10–500 and BH adjustment per returned positive-hit eligible-term family. Tables retain each list's returned terms from the union significant at BH <0.05 in at least one list, including nonsignificant values. Terms not returned for a list are absent rather than zero-filled. There are 1,658 unique union terms and 9,720 total table rows.

Executed versions: R4.6.1, limma3.68.5, edgeR4.10.7, clusterProfiler4.20.3, org.Mm.eg.db3.23.0 and GO.db3.23.1. The analysis tested16,624 genes and used14,674 GO BP-annotated genes as its ORA background. GO metadata date is2026-01-23. Fields: `Annot`=GO ID, `Term`=description, `Annotated`=term genes in background, `Significant`=query overlap count, `Pvalue`=raw ORA upper-tail probability, `Padj`=within-list BH, and `GeneID`=comma-delimited query overlap Entrez IDs.

The application tests import and cluster these exact tables, inspect unique row identity and missing values, and compare saved/restored raw data. They do not repeat differential-expression/enrichment estimation, infer pathway activation, validate biological truth, or compare algorithms on identical effective gene features. Exact source hashes and generation metadata are documented here so fresh CI does not depend on an older worktree or a mutable network download.
